english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for leaving someone behind or abandoning them.

examples.english: You can't desert me here alone.
examples.traditional: 你唔可以掉低我一個人。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 diu6 dai1 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4

english.note: Use 掉低 when someone lets or puts something lower, including deliberately releasing or lowering it.

examples.english: You’re holding the rope—don’t drop it.
examples.traditional: 你拎住條繩，唔好掉低佢呀。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ling1 zyu6 tiu4 sing4 m4 hou2 diu6 dai1 keoi5 aa3
